description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Ellapola, Balangoda D/S Division, Ratnapura District (25/5514121)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and property ownership matters, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, owner details, and property particulars under the Registration of Title Act.
